Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Nihonium (Nh) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a mine gallery of rough rock walls, timber props, an ore cart on its track and a line of hanging lamps
Time of day: cool white overhead light, flat and bright; flat white light with crisp edges, no warm glow.
Outfit: a formal Chinese hanfu — cross-collar ruqun with wide flowing sleeves, high-waisted skirt and a sash — in bright cobalt blue; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; styled with a few thin stacked bangles on one wrist; right now — a splash of water has just soaked her clothes — the damp fabric clings to her body line and darkens in patches, a few wet strands of hair stick to her neck and cheek; the fabric stays opaque, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: crouching low on her heels.
COMPOSITION: a full-body shot, her complete head, hands and feet inside the frame with restrained margins; body facing the camera; head tilted slightly, her face turned a little toward the right of the frame; camera slightly above, looking down at her; a wall or backdrop of the place close behind her; her head and body angles are set by this line, not taken from the attached image.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests on her knee.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a small round red-lacquered case holding one pressed morning-glory flower and three tiny gold beads at chest height; it is all she holds.
LEGS: crouched on the balls of her feet, knees bent.
GAZE: her eyes rest on what she holds.
EXPRESSION: heavy-lidded eyes, lips slightly parted and relaxed, brow smooth.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — nihonium: a synthetic superheavy element, the first ever discovered and named in the far east of the world, named for the land of the rising sun; a team at an eastern research institute fired zinc ions at a bismuth target day and night for nine years, from 2004 to 2012, and caught only three atoms in all; a century earlier a chemist from the same land had announced a new element under a similar name that was struck from the tables, and what he had really found turned out to be another element, so the name came back after a hundred years; it sits below thallium and is predicted to be a heavy, soft metal, but its atoms last only seconds — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: statuesque, long-legged, with a natural neck length — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text or numbers other than her element's own symbol and atomic number, no logo or watermark. No animals or other creatures.
